data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'arza', meaning 'to yearn or desire'. In Islamic culture, Aarzu represents the deep longing and spiritual yearning for Allah and His love. It is a name filled with hope and aspiration, symbolizing the pursuit of a deeper connection with the divine. The name Aarzu carries the meaning “Yearning, Desiring” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aarzu usually hope their child will grow to embody yearning, desiring and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of unwavering faith and devotion to Allah.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aarzu total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
